install_plugin_from_github: install a hermes plugin from a GitHub owner/repo shorthand into the user plugins directory
update_installed_plugin: update an installed hermes plugin by pulling latest changes from its git remote
remove_installed_plugin: remove an installed hermes plugin by name and delete its directory
enable_disable_plugin: enable or disable a hermes plugin to control whether it loads on next session
list_and_toggle_plugins: list all installed and bundled hermes plugins with their enabled status and toggle them interactively
